name: Royal Dutch LV Logistics
note: Dutch logistics provider headquartered in Vlaardingen, 'originally a Dutch family business' per its own about-us page (lv-logistics.com/about-us). Ownership lead, not yet sufficient: company news (lv-logistics.com/about-us/news/board-member-christopher-lewin-leaves-lv-logistics, 3 March 2026) says long-serving chairman Christopher Lewin retired in February 2026 and 'will remain involved with LV Logistics as a shareholder', and Jonathan Lewin left the board in December 2025 — the owning family is not named as controlling owner in any source found. Needs a company-register or annual-accounts source before a rating.
